title: Button defaults to submit inside forms
reasoning: The shared Button renders a native <button> when asChild is false and forwards props without setting a default type. In HTML, a button inside a form defaults to type="submit", so ordinary action buttons used in forms can submit the form unintentionally unless every caller remembers to pass type="button". Because this is a reusable UI primitive, the impact can appear far from the component definition.
recommendation: Default the native button case to type="button" while still allowing callers to override with type="submit" or type="reset". Take care not to pass a button-only default through Slot when asChild is true.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are included for these UI primitives, and there is no interaction test covering Button behavior inside a form.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a React Testing Library test rendering Button inside a form with an onSubmit spy, click it without a type prop, and assert the submit handler is not called; add a second assertion that type="submit" still submits.
minimumFixScope: Update app/components/ui/button.tsx to apply a default type only for the non-asChild native button render path.
